column1: # DOTT (Day of the Tentacle, DOS floppy, Korean patch), default preset: 2 bpp anti-aliased.
# One SVF per distinct cell of the patch (2x its korean0N.fnt header): cs3, cs5 and cs8 share 18x24.
# Output names follow the source font, <font><px>[variant].SVF (SCUMM_FONTS.md, "Face file names"); a name another
# plan also writes (the same font, size, cell and ascent) comes out byte for byte the same, one shared file.
# bake-scumm-fonts.sh dottu.tsv GAMEDIR OUT all-hangul.txt (no .trs: every KS X 1001 syllable is baked).
